answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 6 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The prism chain is verified at intake and dune publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 6 epochs old, anchored at a wander checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 328 aliases cost 147 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
